title: Protocol for cell preparation and gene delivery in HEK293T and C2C12 cells
protocol: Seed 4.5 × 10^5 - 6.0 × 10^5 HEK293T cells per 3.5 cm dish in 2 mL of complete growth medium.
Incubate seeded cells overnight at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Transfect cells with plasmids using Lipofectamine™ 3000 Reagent according to manufacturer’s instructions.
For HEK293 cells, transfect cells with 1 μg Myc-MG53 plasmid using 2 μL P3000™ Reagent and 3 μL Lipofectamine™ 3000 Reagent per 3.5 cm dish.
Switch to fresh culture medium after the incubation period.
Lysate cells in lysis buffer for further experimentation such as co-immunoprecipitation.
Perform Western blotting to determine the amount of target protein overexpressed.
Seed myoblasts in dishes to reach 70%–80% confluence.
Replace complete growth medium with differentiation medium (DMEM with 2% donor equine serum).
Add adenovirus into the medium and swirl briefly to distribute uniformly.
Determine M.O.I. of adenovirus empirically for each experiment based on biological effects.
Change medium (fresh differentiation medium) 24 hours after infection.
Culture myoblast cells in differentiation medium for at least 4 days to induce their differentiation into myotubes.
Change medium every 2 days during the differentiation process.
Harvest cells after differentiation for at least 4 days.
